notes.title: Runespell: Overture Update Released
notes.content:
Fixes

  • "Steal stack" AI issue: sometimes the AI would give an attack hand to the player. No more gifts from the AI!
  • Achievements unlocked in the demo are carried over to full version on Steam. One battle and a save in the full version is needed to activate the sync
  • Gathering the magic achievement now shows progress in Steam client
  • Runespell XL now with progress bar to show the number of unique battles needed to unlock achievement
  • Resolutions should not reset to a low resolution when going from window mode to fullscreen anymore
  • Corrected some texts in the game tutorial

notes.title: New Release - Runespell: Overture, 10% off!
notes.content:
Runespell: Overture is now available on Steam and is 10% off through July 26th!

Take on the role of the Changeling, son of a monster god, and fight through more than 30 types of monsters to reach your nemesis. Combining RPG elements with Poker mechanics, Runespell: Overture offers a new take on the puzzle adventure genre!

notes.title: Two days to go until first players enter Beta stage 2
notes.content:
We are nearing the conclusion of Beta stage 1. So far about 200 people have helped testing the game and where needed stating improvements.

See www.runespell.com/forums

We look forward to starting Beta stage 2. People can still sign up, but will be let in later as the current testers of course.

Beta stage 2 will focus on:
Monsters, AI, Deck cycling, Learning curve and storyline. It will offer a larger slice of the game that later will only be available through buying the game:).

notes.title: 1 Euro <> 1 Dollar <> 1 GBP
notes.content:
We will be releasing full pricing details shortly, but our official Steamgroup, Facebook, Twitter and Forum members will be the first to get pricing details:

We have always decided that the US $ price would be $9.99, but had not considered the Euro price yet. The Euro price will be set to €8.99. The British price will be £7.99.

Hopefully we all agree that there are currency and VAT differences between countries and regions and after adding some psychological pricing rules above prices should reflect these differences.
